data.title: Which agents besides Claude Code can take a prompt or session hook
data.description: Many-agents is a top request (spec-kit #1213, #9, #377). The prompt hook is Claude Code only; AGENTS.md instructions alone were measured at 1 in 10. Find out which of Codex, Cursor, Copilot, Gemini CLI expose prompt or session hooks, and how, before writing any.
